PLAN "12-Week General Strength - Spine-Friendly"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build general strength with no heavy spinal loading"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Full Body A":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          leg_press 3x10 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x10 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x10 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x8 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 1m
          child_pose 1m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Full Body B":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          split_squat 3x8 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x10 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x10 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          pallof_press 3x10 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          bird_dog 3x8 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 1m
          cat_cow 1m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Full Body C":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          step_up 3x8 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x10 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 3x10 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 3x15 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          side_plank 2x20s rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 1m
          chest_stretch 1m
